content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before proceeding with your signature, I have one quick adjustment to suggest: - Regarding the relevant clause, the text currently implies that intellectual property may be transferred before full payment is finalized; I propose the following constructive modification: Ownership of all intellectual property created by the Developer shall remain with the Developer until the Developer has received full payment under this Agreement, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client. Please let me know if you are comfortable with this change. Best regards,
